analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is missing validation of the referenced HDF5 dataset’s actual datatype/shape before reading. Mat_H5ReadNextReferenceData derives a destination type and byte size from matvar->class_type metadata (DataType2H5T/ClassType2H5T + computed nbytes), allocates a buffer, and calls H5Dread via Mat_H5ReadData with H5S_ALL for both spaces. If the file’s referenced dataset metadata is inconsistent/corrupted, HDF5’s compact read path (H5D__compact_readvv -> H5VM_memcpyvv -> memcpy) uses invalid source offsets and crashes on read. So the unsafe state propagation is in matio’s reference-data read logic, not in memcpy itself.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a MATLAB v7.3/HDF5 file containing object/reference-driven variables (e.g., under #refs#) where matio infers class_type/dimensions from metadata but the referenced dataset’s real layout/type is malformed or inconsistent. During Mat_VarRead73 -> Mat_H5ReadNextReferenceData, matio computes nelems/nbytes and performs H5Dread without verifying that the referenced dataset datatype and extent are compatible with expected class_type and allocated buffer assumptions. This lets crafted input drive HDF5 into invalid compact-dataset vector copy and a segfault.
